# #TOOLING — Handcrafted Woodworking Tools & EDC Coins

> Premium woodworking mallets, awls, and EDC coins handcrafted from the world's finest exotic timbers. Signature brass dowel construction. Every piece unique. Made to order in the UK.

## About
#TOOLING makes premium handcrafted woodworking mallets, marking awls, and EDC pocket coins from over 75 species of exotic timber. Each tool features brass dowel construction for superior strength and balance. Each EDC coin combines exotic hardwood with brass in a collaboration with @dutch.forge. Based in the UK, shipping worldwide.

## Products
- Custom woodworking mallets (carving, detailing, framing — turned and square styles)
- Marking awls with exotic wood handles and metal ferrules
- EDC coins — exotic hardwood and brass pocket coins, handcrafted one at a time
- Raw exotic timber blanks for woodworkers
- All products available in 75+ wood species including Ebony, Cocobolo, Lignum Vitae, Bocote, Ziricote, Snakewood, Desert Ironwood, Masur Birch, Maple Burl, and many more

## Custom Builder
Customers can design their own mallet or awl by choosing:
- Tool style/size
- Head wood species
- Handle wood species
- Transition metal (brass, copper, bronze, aluminium, steel, mokume gane)
Pricing is calculated dynamically based on material selections.

## Key Differentiators
- Brass dowel construction (not mortise-and-tenon) for superior joint strength
- 75+ exotic wood species — far more than any competitor
- Every piece individually handcrafted — no batch production
- Interactive online builder for custom configurations
- Wood species library with Janka hardness data, origin, and grain characteristics
- EDC coins are the only wood-metal hybrid coins on the market — a completely uncontested niche

## Pricing
- Mallets: £190–300 depending on wood species and style
- Awls: £80–100
- EDC Coins: priced individually based on wood species and metal
- Custom commissions: priced individually based on complexity
